Name: Christmas_Weaver_Feast_Line
$Comment: Elsie's Christmas line in her Harvest Feast conversation. Christmas starts while the feast's last
days still run, and while the feast runs Elsie stands at her feast spot speaking her feast
conversation (NpcPlacements/Harvest_Feast_Weaver_Temple.json takes its feast entry first). This line
lets a player reach her Christmas stall from the first day of Christmas all the same. Once the feast
is over she speaks her Christmas conversation (Dialogues/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Weaver.json), which
opens the stall itself, and the feast conversation is no longer reached.
Dialogues.Ids names her feast conversation alone, since each villager's line opens that villager's
own stall. It lands on the screens the conversation opens on, after a screen's own lines and before
the goodbye group, so goodbye stays last. Season offers it only while Christmas runs; to take it out,
set Enabled false in a file of the same name. The line pays nothing: it opens the stall.
